title: gomphia squamosa
intro: Gomphia squamosa, commonly known as the smooth gomphia, is a plant species that belongs to the family Gomphiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Gomphia squamosa include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and treat respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
